notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: The Immortal Weapons is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of The Immortal Weapons that's tapped and attacking.
When the The Immortal Weapons token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
